Method of Attack: Encrypts victim's files with the .ENC extension
Downloads executable via JS file from SPAM email attachment
Encrypts computer's data and appends .ENC extension
Displays ransom note with payment instructions

Attack Vector: SPAM emails pretending to be bills from Italian energy company Enel with attachment ENEL_BOLLETA.zip containing ENEL_BOLLETA.js
